_source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Alchemical_Hydra and /Strategies (phases, vents, attacks, damage); monsters-complete (hitpoints, attack speed, max hits); the cache for every id. The phase forms follow the Wiki's infobox (serpentine 8615, electric 8619, flame 8620, enraged 8621). Values neither gives are marked _calibrated.

seqs._special: The enraged form has no special seq of its own; the stage 1 one is another skeleton, so its poison plays its own magic attack.
seqs._death: Skeletons: stage_N_death are the transition forms' (head falling), stage_4_death the enraged form's, hydra_death (8258) the final-death form's

names._npcs: The gameval numbers don't follow the phase order: by the Wiki's infobox, hydraboss_4 (8619) is the electric phase and hydraboss_2 (8621) the enraged one, as monsters-complete's 4-tick, 55-max stats for 8621 agree.

combat._empoweredDamage: Wiki: the wrong vent raises its damage by up to 50% (infobox 17x2 -> 26x2)
combat._calibrated: the vent cadence and how long weakening lasts, pool, lightning and fire timings
combat._geyserTicks: hydra_geyser (seq 8279) runs 160 client cycles, 5.3 ticks; the vents spray, and act on the Hydra, for that long
combat._headFallTicks: hydra_stage_4_death runs 3 ticks before the final form takes over

lightning._calibrated: how long a current lasts and how fast it closes in

fire._walk: Wiki: it walks to the centre of the chamber first and stuns the player on arriving; how long it may take to get there and how long the stun lasts are calibrated
fire._breatheAfter: a tick after it stops at the centre, so a melee player following it lands beside it ('2, center') before the stun; a stun on the tick it arrives left them on the corner's diagonal, out of reach
fire._walls: Wiki: 5x5 layers of fire to the player's sides. The geometry follows the Tile Packs plugin's 'Alchemical Hydra (melee)' pack (TrevorMDev/tile-packs b392d16, pack 47) and its video (Dehsow 2026, youtube _PSdH0KcDHc): '2, center' (1364,10271), '3, skip' (1363,10270) and '4th attack' (1361,10270) stay clear, and the west stream meets the wall at 'Skip when fire hits wall' (1356,10267). The video's clock has the special start about 15:23 and the tracking fire leave about 15:26-27; the spread is calibrated to that, not a capture
fire._calibrated: how long the fires burn, the tick before the tracking fire moves and how much faster it gets with distance

kill._respawn: the Wiki infobox's 43 ticks (its Strategies page says 20 seconds)
